sketches.mechanism: Goroutine launched with no channel or WaitGroup — the main function exits before the goroutine can speak
sketches.resonance: A voice that begins speaking but is never heard, because the world that spawned it doesn't wait.

sketches.mechanism: Variable moved on first use, so the second use is a compile error — the borrow checker enforces that what is given away cannot be kept
sketches.resonance: Once you give yourself to someone, the compiler itself forbids you from being whole on your own again.

sketches.mechanism: An infinite list that is never forced — laziness means the endless thing exists peacefully because no one demands it
sketches.resonance: An infinite longing that only becomes painful when you try to evaluate it all at once.
sketches.draft:
longing :: [()]
longing = () : longing

main :: IO ()
main = seq (head longing) (return ())
